about: A ready call for each tool's card (tool_find { tool }): its arguments filled from the open document (=facts.… as in nexthint.json) and the values the agent must give marked. fill: each value to give (keep: true, a worked value to change; unless: an expression that, when it has a value, fills it). Owner, 22 Nov.
